description: Logs. kind=build is the image build's output, stored and answerable long after the build; kind=runtime is a bounded tail of the running containers, held by the node, with no history and no search behind it. For kind=runtime, `service` narrows the tail to one service of the project — without it every service is interleaved, which on a project with more than one is most of what you read. The names are the ones get_project_detail lists.
name: get_logs
title: Read logs
